theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_pfi_isIntegerMultiplicity_of_pieces
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A B : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict A), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (N : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (g : ℕ → Euclid P → ℤ) (η : ℕ → Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (Q : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (N j)) → (∀ j, N j ⊆ U) → (∀ j, CountablyRectifiable n (N j)) → (∀ j, Measurable (g j)) → (∀ j, ∀ y ∈ N j, g j y ≠ 0) → (∀ j, StronglyMeasurable (η j)) → (∀ j, ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n].restrict (N j)), ∃ T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (N j) y T ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η j y) T) → ∑' j, ∫⁻ y in N j, ((g j y).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Q ω = ∑' j, ∫ y in N j, (g j y : ℝ) * η j y ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y) ∂μHE[n]) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Q
